propositions: Completion-verification close gate fails verdict-less due to runaway duplicate tool-call loops, request-budget exhaustion, and flat 100,000-char context ceiling that rejects live tickets with 121,147-char context.
Per-criterion recovery fan-out creates worst-case 440 requests for 22-criteria tickets with 2.67M context re-sent, violating d59e invariants.
Verified criterion verdicts are lost on failure; recovery paths cannot recover to full-coverage verdict when primary run dies with partial progress banked.
Completion verification has no deterministic no-LLM fallback; a run with banked progress can die verdict-less if recovery exhausts budget.
Duplicate read-only tool calls inside agentic runs are re-executed instead of memoized, causing wasteful redundant LLM calls across all agentic workflows.
